title: N56: VIX/GARCH ratio formally validated as VaR predictor — AUC 0.929, OOS AUC 0.973
description: Ran logistic regression of VaR 1% violations on VIX/GARCH ratio for SPY 2020-2025 (1507 days, 22 violations). Coefficient=2.972, odds ratio=19.53x per unit. AUC-ROC=0.929 in-sample. Out-of-sample (train 2020-22, test 2023-25): AUC=0.973 with 9 violations. 100% of violations at ratio>1.3, 91% at ratio>1.5. This formally validates the K11 finding with proper statistical framework. The VIX/GARCH ratio is not just a heuristic — it's a near-perfect discriminator of VaR reliability. Interpretation: wh
